certification.name: EC-Council Information Security Analyst Professional Certificate
certification.description: Five-course entry-level program covering information security fundamentals, risk assessment, security operations, incident response and threat hunting. Course-based certificate assessed through hands-on labs and projects, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 4 months at 10 hours a week.
